title: The 6 AI tools solo founders actually pay for
caption: 100 AI tools get hyped. Solo founders pay for 6. The stack that earns its subscription. Save this.

slides.headline: The 6 AI tools solo founders
slides.sub: Not the hyped ones. The ones that earn it.

slides.title: Claude — the thinking layer
slides.body: Strategy, writing, analysis, hard decisions. The one tool that replaces a thinking partner, not just a task-doer. ~$20/mo. Non-negotiable.

slides.title: Cursor — the shipping layer
slides.body: Reads your repo, writes the code, runs the tests. Turns 'I have an idea' into 'it's deployed' without a dev team. ~$20/mo.

slides.title: Perplexity — the research layer
slides.body: Replaces the 6-tab research spiral with a sourced answer in 2 minutes. The time it saves pays the sub in week one. ~$20/mo.

slides.title: An image gen — the visual layer
slides.body: Midjourney or ChatGPT images. Every brand needs visuals; agencies charge $500/asset. This is the highest-ROI line on the list.

slides.title: Transcription — the capture layer
slides.body: Every call, voice note, idea → searchable text. The cheapest tool here and the one founders underrate the most.

slides.title: An automation layer
slides.body: n8n / Make / Zapier. The glue that makes the other 5 run without you. The difference between tools and a system.

slides.title: ~$100/mo
bullets: Replaces a researcher, a junior dev, a designer's first pass, and an ops VA.
Break-even: one client, one shipped feature, or 4 saved hours.
Everything else is a nice-to-have until these 6 are running.
